newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index gains on Industrials.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index gains on Industrials.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index gained 49.11 points to 3468.01 on sharp price gains on selected industrial shares, bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 14.8 million shillings ($0.27 million) on 269,157 shares compared to 37.8 million shillings on 445,767 shares on Monday, floor dealers said on Tuesday.
Kenya Power & Lighting gained 11 shillings to 173 while East African Packaging gained 14 to 67. A broker said some companies were quiet for long periods, then erupted.
"These shares are like dormant volcanoes," he told Reuters.
Another broker said while demand for the shares, especially Kenya Power, had gone up, prices surged mainly because of a lack of supply -- investors did not want to sell.
Trade on other boards was dull: "There is nothing exciting happening in the market right now. Everyone wants the current level of prices to maintain," one floor dealer said.
Barclays Bank was unchanged at 112. Standard Chartered Bank was also unchanged at 46. Kenya Commercial Bank was unchanged at 95 while Diamond Trust Bank Kenya eased to 31 from 31.50.
Brooke Bond closed at 123 while Rea Vipingo shed 50 cents to close at 76.50.
Foreign investors traded Uchumi at 42 from 40, Firestone at between 28 and 30 from 27 and Sasini Tea & Coffee at 76 from 77.
The Central Bank of Kenya floating rate treasury bond traded 500,000 shillings at 103.8000 percent from 103.8787 percent.
